4th supersonic demonstrator of the PERSEUS project at CNES. Directly derived from SERA3 with many technical improvements, increased measurement plan and confirmation of operational know-how.

Until December 2019.

projects.title: DIAMANT subsonic demontrator
projects.description:
DIAMANT is a subsonic rocket developped & manufactured by Ipsa Space Systems. This rocket has a role of standardization for the next rockets of the club. Equiped with all the required electronics & sensors to get the flight data, the main experience  was to film the flight at 360 ° with stabilization of the camera in roll relative to the rocket. 

Successful launch during summer 2019 from Tarbes (C'SPACE).

projects.title: MINI-APTERROS demonstrator
projects.description: The Mini-APTERROS Project aims to set up a fundamental technological brick necessary for the realization of a reusable biliquid VTVL first stage demonstrator, which will prefigure the rocket demonstrator of DREAM-ON. The objective is to work on the GNC by making an application on a small-scale demonstrator.

projects.title: SERA3 supersonic demonstrator
projects.description:
3rd supersonic rocket of the PERSEUS project of CNES marking a step in terms of size and performance compared to SERA1 and 2 in particular by the passage to acluster of 3 powder thrusters (against 1 on SERA1 and 2) and a more substantial takeoff weight .

Successful launch in spring 2017 from ESRANGE (SSC).

newHeat provides solar and recovery heat for large heat consumers.

We design, develop, finance, build and operate solar thermal plants and waste heat recovery equipment adapted to the needs of our customers, ensuring a reliable and competitive heat supply without any CO2 emissions.

Missions:
• Develop the company's commercial activity in the industry sector: over €250m of commercial opportunity under responsibility (from prospection to closed deal)
• Develop the ENR&R projects signed to enable their implementation

Results:
• Prospecting, development of new offers and responses to the company's first tenders
• 100 M€ of commercial proposals and 37 M€ of projects signed
• > 200 000 tons of CO2 avoided
• Sale and development of the largest solar thermal plant in France and the first in the world coupled with interseasonal storage for an industrial company

With the entrance of new energy applications; the maturity of renewable energy sources; the growing number of small-scale energy production units and the need to reduce energy consumption related to the rise of the world’s population and the global warming: the energy world is changing. 

We are moving from a centralized energy sector to a decentralized energy world in which the consumers become prosumers. It’s why E.ON Connecting Energies, part of the B2B business of E.ON is focusing on innovative solutions to embrace the Energy transition. 

For this purpose, the Global Domain Flexibility is developing its virtual power plant to connect and steer more than 1,000 assets, making the energy network smarter and generating additional revenue for customers.

As an intern within the Platform Operations & Operational Excellence team, my role was to
• Support the team in his role of IT/Business coordinator,
• Develop the platform and its user interfaces,
• Improve the operational processes,
• Carry out a European benchmark of energy companies that market or use SaaS for their VPP business.

Founded in 2009, Energy Pool manages and optimizes the electricity consumption of customers from the industrial and tertiary sectors: steelmaker, metallurgist, cement, paper, chemical industry, food industry, etc.

Energy Pool's solutions make it possible to identify the consumption flexibilities of various industrial processes (electrolysis, furnace, crusher, etc.) and self-generation means (battery, generator, cogeneration) and then to develop them in the energy / reserve markets. 

Depending on the needs of the electrical system and market opportunities, Energy Pool asks its customers to reduce their consumption (curtailement) or conversely encourages them to consume at the right time (stimulation).

Participation in the process of continuous improvement of the operations carried out by Energy Pool:
• Supervision of the rewriting of technical procedures
• Implementation of a document management method based on the audit carried out on the OPS center
• Implementation of a  information management method within the operational department
• Implementation of a monthly audit and start-up procedure for the operational center
• Reflection and design of an example of a new SharePoint tree
